excerpt: Private, local transcription and system-wide dictation for Apple Silicon. - VladUZH/qwen-scribe
content_html:
Private, local transcription and system-wide dictation for Apple Silicon.

Qwen Scribe transcribes audio and video with Qwen3-ASR running through mlx-qwen3-asr on the Mac's Metal GPU. There is no account, API key, or Qwen Scribe cloud service. Audio and transcript text stay on the Mac.

Project status: v0.2.0-beta.1. Core transcription, history, and dictation work. Releases are source-only for now: app builds are not yet Developer ID signed or notarized, so you build locally with make app. Release automation is in place (RELEASING.md); signed and notarized binaries follow once Developer ID credentials are configured, see ROADMAP.md. Feedback and careful testing are welcome.

The interface above uses synthetic demo text; no private recording or transcript is shown.

Highlights

  • Drag-and-drop audio and video transcription in a focused local web interface
  • Qwen3-ASR 1.7B for accuracy or 0.6B for speed
  • Automatic language detection, optional forced language, vocabulary hints, word timestamps, and SRT export
  • Automatic local transcript history with search, reopen, export-all, individual delete, and delete-all controls
  • Hold the configured push-to-talk key (right Command by default; right Option or right Control if you prefer) in any text field, speak, then release to transcribe locally and paste at the cursor
  • Menu-bar status item with the dictation state, a push-to-talk key picker, and explicit restart and quit controls
  • A non-focus-stealing HUD for Listening, Transcribing, success, and failure states
  • Localhost-only API with Host and browser-origin checks

Requirements

  • Apple Silicon Mac
  • macOS 14 or newer, as required by current MLX releases
  • Native Python 3.12 or newer, as required by the pinned NumPy in requirements-lock.txt
  • ffmpeg for non-WAV audio and video — Homebrew (brew install ffmpeg) or MacPorts (sudo port install ffmpeg). The Mac app looks on the standard Homebrew and MacPorts paths and then on your login shell's PATH, so any install your terminal can see should work.
  • Apple Command Line Tools to build the app from source: xcode-select --install

The 1.7B model needs roughly 3.4 GB of unified memory and the 0.6B model roughly 1.2 GB, in addition to normal application overhead. Model weights are not included in this repository.

Build and run the Mac app

From a downloaded or cloned source directory:

make app
open "dist/Qwen Scribe.app"

The generated app is self-contained except for Python dependencies and model weights, which it installs or downloads on first use. You may move both apps from dist/ to /Applications after building:

  • Qwen Scribe.app starts the server and desktop dictation helper.
  • Stop Qwen Scribe.app stops only processes started by Qwen Scribe.

An app built locally is ad-hoc signed. If Gatekeeper blocks a downloaded build, open it once, then approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway (macOS 15 removed the right-click Open bypass). Stable public binaries should be signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized; see ROADMAP.md.

Server logs are written to ~/Library/Logs/QwenScribe.log.

Terminal alternative

./run.sh

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8990. The first transcription downloads the selected model once. Subsequent use works offline once dependencies and weights are cached.

Desktop dictation permissions

Desktop dictation starts with the Mac app. On first launch, allow Qwen Scribe in System Settings → Privacy & Security for:

  • Microphone — records while the push-to-talk key is held
  • Input Monitoring — detects that modifier while another app is active
  • Accessibility — pastes the finished text into the focused field

After changing Input Monitoring or Accessibility, stop and reopen Qwen Scribe. File transcription remains available when these optional permissions are not granted.

The helper watches modifier-change events and reacts only to the configured push-to-talk key (right Command unless you change it in the web interface or the menu bar). It snapshots the pasteboard in memory, pastes the transcription, and restores the previous pasteboard if it has not changed. Without Accessibility access it cannot insert text at all, so it leaves the transcript on the clipboard and reports the failure instead of claiming success. See PRIVACY.md for the complete data and permission behavior.

Local files and deletion

Data Default location
Saved transcripts ~/Library/Application Support/Qwen Scribe/transcripts
Settings ~/Library/Application Support/Qwen Scribe/settings.json
Private runtime ~/Library/Application Support/Qwen Scribe/runtime
Diagnostic log ~/Library/Logs/QwenScribe.log
Downloaded models ~/.cache/huggingface/hub

Saved transcripts are readable, unencrypted JSON. Use the history controls to delete one or all. Normal filesystem deletion is not secure erasure, and local backups may retain copies.

Environment variables

These are read by server.py, so they apply to ./run.sh and to the server the Mac app starts:

Variable Default Purpose
QWEN_SCRIBE_DATA_DIR ~/Library/Application Support/Qwen Scribe Where transcript history is stored
QWEN_SCRIBE_MODEL_DIR ./models Where a locally quantized model is looked up
QWEN_SCRIBE_PORT 8990 Port for the local server

QWEN_SCRIBE_PORT only applies when you start the server yourself with ./run.sh. The Mac app and the desktop dictation helper both address 127.0.0.1:8990 directly, so dictation will not find a server on another port.

Development

make setup       # create .venv and install the reviewed dependency lock
make test        # run lightweight API/history tests without model weights
make check       # tests, source compilation, and publication hygiene
make app         # build ad-hoc-signed app bundles in dist/
make package     # create a beta release zip in dist/

make app compiles native/DictationHelper.m as the arm64 bundle executable, embeds the server launcher and tracked sources as signed resources, validates its property lists, signs it, and verifies the result. Keeping the privacy-sensitive recorder as the bundle executable gives macOS one stable app identity for Accessibility, Input Monitoring, and Microphone access. Set CODESIGN_IDENTITY to a Developer ID identity for a release build; notarization is intentionally a separate release-owner step.

Optional 8-bit conversion

For source-based use, a local 8-bit conversion can reduce decoding latency:

source .venv/bin/activate
python quantize_8bit.py
python compare_models.py path/to/representative-recording.m4a

This creates a multi-gigabyte models/ directory that is intentionally ignored by Git. Validate names and numbers on representative recordings before relying on a quantized model.

Architecture

Browser UI ──localhost──> FastAPI job queue ──> MLX / Qwen3-ASR
                                  │
                                  └──> local JSON transcript history

Push-to-talk ──> native macOS helper ──> temporary WAV ──> same job queue
        focused app <── restored clipboard + Command-V <── transcript

The API serializes GPU jobs to avoid memory contention. Media is staged under a random temporary filename and removed when processing finishes.

Contributing and security

Read CONTRIBUTING.md before proposing changes. Please report vulnerabilities according to SECURITY.md, not in a public issue. The planned release sequence is documented in ROADMAP.md.

Project source and issue tracking live at VladUZH/qwen-scribe.

License and project identity

Qwen Scribe is licensed under Apache-2.0. Third-party licenses and attribution are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

Qwen Scribe is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Alibaba Cloud, the Qwen team, or Apple Inc. Qwen and other names may be trademarks of their respective owners.

content_html_zh:
Apple Silicon 的私人本地转录和全系统听写。

Qwen Scribe 使用在 Mac 的 Metal GPU 上通过 mlx-qwen3-asr 运行的 Qwen3-ASR 转录音频和视频。 没有帐户、API 密钥或 Qwen Scribe 云服务。 音频和转录文本保留在 Mac 上。

项目状态：v0.2.0-beta.1。 核心转录、历史记录和听写工作。 目前版本仅包含源代码：应用程序构建尚未经过开发者 ID 签名或公证，因此您可以使用 make app 在本地构建。 发布自动化已就位（RELEASING.md）；配置开发人员 ID 凭据后，将生成经过签名和公证的二进制文件，请参阅 ROADMAP.md。 欢迎提供反馈和仔细测试。

上面的界面使用了合成的演示文本；没有显示私人录音或文字记录。

亮点

  • 在集中的本地 Web 界面中拖放音频和视频转录
  • Qwen3-ASR 1.7B 精度或 0.6B 速度
  • 自动语言检测、可选强制语言、词汇提示、单词时间戳和 SRT 导出
  • 自动本地记录历史记录，具有搜索、重新打开、全部导出、单独删除和全部删除控件
  • 在任何文本字段中按住配置的一键通键（默认为右侧 Command；如果您愿意，则为右侧 Option 或右侧 Control），讲话，然后松开以进行本地转录并粘贴到光标处
  • 具有听写状态的菜单栏状态项、一键通按键选择器以及显式重新启动和退出控件
  • 用于监听、转录、成功和失败状态的非焦点窃取 HUD
  • 仅限本地主机的 API，具有主机和浏览器来源检查

要求

  • 苹果硅Mac
  • macOS 14 或更高版本，根据当前 MLX 版本的要求
  • 本机 Python 3.12 或更高版本，根据 requests-lock.txt 中固定的 NumPy 的要求
  • 用于非 WAV 音频和视频的 ffmpeg — Homebrew (brew install ffmpeg) 或 MacPorts (sudo port install ffmpeg)。 Mac 应用程序会查找标准 Homebrew 和 MacPorts 路径，然后查找登录 shell 的 PATH，因此您的终端可以看到的任何安装都应该有效。
  • 用于从源代码构建应用程序的 Apple 命令行工具： xcode-select --install

除了正常的应用程序开销之外，1.7B 模型需要大约 3.4 GB 的统一内存，0.6B 模型需要大约 1.2 GB 的统一内存。 模型权重不包含在此存储库中。

构建并运行 Mac 应用程序

从下载或克隆的源目录：

make app
open "dist/Qwen Scribe.app"

生成的应用程序是独立的，除了 Python 依赖项和模型权重之外，它会在首次使用时安装或下载。 构建后，您可以将这两个应用程序从 dist/ 移动到 /Applications：

  • Qwen Scribe.app 启动服务器和桌面听写助手。
  • Stop Qwen Scribe.app 仅停止由 Qwen Scribe 启动的进程。

本地构建的应用程序是临时签名的。 如果 Gatekeeper 阻止下载的版本，请将其打开一次，然后在“系统设置”→“隐私和安全”→“无论如何打开”下批准它（macOS 15 删除了右键单击“打开”旁路）。 稳定的公共二进制文件应使用 Apple 开发者 ID 进行签名并经过公证；请参阅 ROADMAP.md。

服务器日志写入 ~/Library/Logs/QwenScribe.log。

终端替代方案

./run.sh

然后打开http://127.0.0.1:8990。第一个转录会下载一次所选模型。 一旦依赖项和权重被缓存，后续使用就可以离线工作。

桌面听写权限

桌面听写从 Mac 应用程序开始。 首次启动时，在系统设置 → 隐私和安全中允许 Qwen Scribe 用于：

  • 麦克风 — 按住一键通键时进行​​录音
  • 输入监控 - 在另一个应用程序处于活动状态时检测该修改器
  • 辅助功能 — 将完成的文本粘贴到焦点字段中

更改输入监控或辅助功能后，停止并重新打开 Qwen Scribe。 当未授予这些可选权限时，文件转录仍然可用。

帮助程序监视修改器更改事件，并仅对配置的一键通键做出反应（右侧命令，除非您在 Web 界面或菜单栏中更改它）。 它对内存中的粘贴板进行快照，粘贴转录内容，如果没有更改，则恢复之前的粘贴板。 如果没有辅助功能访问权限，它根本无法插入文本，因此它将记录保留在剪贴板上并报告失败而不是声称成功。 有关完整的数据和权限行为，请参阅 PRIVACY.md。

本地文件及删除

Data 默认位置
保存的成绩单 〜/图书馆/应用程序支持/Qwen Scribe/成绩单
设置 〜/库/应用程序支持/Qwen Scribe/settings.json
私人运行时 〜/库/应用程序支持/Qwen Scribe/runtime
诊断日志 〜/库/日志/QwenScribe.log
下载的模型 〜/.cache/huggingface/hub

保存的文字记录是可读的、未加密的 JSON。 使用历史记录控件删除一项或全部。 正常的文件系统删除不是安全擦除，本地备份可能会保留副本。

环境变量

这些由 server.py 读取，因此它们适用于 ./run.sh 和 Mac 应用程序启动的服务器：

多变的 默认 目的
QWEN_SCRIBE_DATA_DIR 〜/库/应用程序支持/Qwen Scribe 记录历史记录的存储位置
QWEN_SCRIBE_MODEL_DIR ./模型 查找局部量化模型的位置
QWEN_SCRIBE_PORT 8990 本地服务器的端口

QWEN_SCRIBE_PORT 仅在您使用 ./run.sh 自行启动服务器时适用。 Mac 应用程序和桌面听写助手都直接寻址 127.0.0.1:8990，因此听写不会在其他端口上找到服务器。

发展

make setup       # create .venv and install the reviewed dependency lock
make test        # run lightweight API/history tests without model weights
make check       # tests, source compilation, and publication hygiene
make app         # build ad-hoc-signed app bundles in dist/
make package     # create a beta release zip in dist/

make app 将 native/DictationHelper.m 编译为 arm64 捆绑包可执行文件，嵌入服务器启动器并跟踪源作为签名资源，验证其属性列表，对其进行签名并验证结果。 将隐私敏感录音机保留为捆绑可执行文件可为 macOS 提供一个稳定的应用程序身份，用于辅助功能、输入监控和麦克风访问。 将 CODESIGN_IDENTITY 设置为发布版本的开发人员 ID 身份；公证故意是一个单独的发布所有者步骤。

可选8位转换

对于基于源的使用，本地 8 位转换可以减少解码延迟：

source .venv/bin/activate
python quantize_8bit.py
python compare_models.py path/to/representative-recording.m4a

这会创建一个多 GB 的 models/ 目录，Git 会故意忽略该目录。 在依赖量化模型之前验证代表性录音上的名称和号码。

建筑学

Browser UI ──localhost──> FastAPI job queue ──> MLX / Qwen3-ASR
                                  │
                                  └──> local JSON transcript history

Push-to-talk ──> native macOS helper ──> temporary WAV ──> same job queue
        focused app <── restored clipboard + Command-V <── transcript

API 序列化 GPU 作业以避免内存争用。 媒体以随机临时文件名暂存，并在处理完成后删除。

贡献和安全

在提出更改建议之前，请阅读 CONTRIBUTING.md。 请根据 SECURITY.md 报告漏洞，而不是在公共问题中报告。 计划的发布顺序记录在 ROADMAP.md 中。

项目来源和问题实时跟踪在 VladUZH/qwen-scribe。

Qwen Scribe 已获得 Apache-2.0 许可。 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 中列出了第三方许可证和归属。

Qwen Scribe 是一个独立的社区项目。 它不隶属于阿里云、Qwen 团队或 Apple Inc.，也不受其认可或赞助。Qwen 和其他名称可能是其各自所有者的商标。
